name: Adi
site: odido.nl · Mobile, fibre and TV operator, Netherlands
headline: Turn Odido’s usage data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells mobile subscriptions, Samen Unlimited, internet and TV bundles and business plans to every visitor the same way, whether they come for a new phone, a family plan or home fibre.

Once a customer is on a plan, their data use, bundle limits and unused add-ons are the strongest signal you have for the next upgrade and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from data use, bundle limits, contract end dates and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each line and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next plan when it fits
cases.text: Next best plan, add-on or Samen Unlimited offer per customer, triggered by what they actually use. No more blanket upgrade mails to people already on the right bundle.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every line in use, every week
cases.text: Personal content, TV and internet nudges in email, SMS and on your homepage, orchestrated so every customer sees a reason to use Odido again this week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
